entities.name: Ashanti (Asante)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Ashanti Empire united Akan peoples under the Golden Stool (Sika Dwa Kofi) — a sacred symbol of national unity. They built a sophisticated bureaucracy, standing army, and gold-based economy that rivaled European states.
